tools.name: promakeup_search_pros
tools.description: Use when the user asks "find a makeup [category] in [city] who does [service]". Returns ranked, verified-by-default listings. Example: "Find a bridal makeup artist in Tel Aviv". Each result includes a `profile_url` you can cite back to the user.

query.description: Free-text search across name and bio. Capped at 100 chars to bound the ILIKE cost on a 214K-row Business table.

category.description: Single category filter. Omit to search all categories.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US") or full country name.

city.description: City name in English (or local script for non-Latin cities).

verified_only.description: Restrict to verified listings. Defaults to true.

tools.name: promakeup_get_business_by_slug
tools.description: Use when you have a pro.makeup URL or slug and want the full structured profile. The slug is the trailing path segment of `https://pro.makeup/{category}/{country}/{city}/{slug}`. Returns name, location, services, photos, verification, opening hours, and a canonical `profile_url`.

slug.description: The trailing path segment of the canonical URL (e.g. "israel/tel-aviv/jane-doe").

tools.name: promakeup_get_business_by_phone
tools.description: Use when the user contacted a business by phone and you only have the phone number. Returns the listing when exactly one matches; signals `ambiguous: true` when multiple do (call promakeup_search_pros to disambiguate). Phone must be E.164 with leading `+`. Reverse-phone lookup is owner-attribution data and REQUIRES a Bearer token with the `owner:read` scope — see https://pro.makeup/.well-known/auth.md.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format with leading "+" (e.g. "+972501234567"). Returns the listing if exactly one matches; "ambiguous" when many match (use search_pros instead).

tools.name: promakeup_get_business
tools.description: Use when you already hold a Business id (nanoid) — typically because you stored it from a prior tool call or webhook. Returns the same full profile shape as get_business_by_slug.

tools.name: promakeup_list_services_nearby
tools.description: Use when the user wants verified pros within a radius of a known point. Example: "Makeup artists doing bridal within 10km of these coordinates". Inputs are WGS-84 lat/lon; radius defaults to 10km.

tools.name: promakeup_list_schools
tools.description: Use when the user asks about makeup schools, programs, or specific qualifications (e.g. MUAQS). Returns school listings filterable by country, city, and certification offered.

tools.name: promakeup_get_discovery_summary
tools.description: Use when the user wants a sense of what is on pro.makeup right now — totals plus a sample of recently added listings with avatars. Cheap; safe to call to "warm up" before a more specific search.

tools.name: promakeup_emit_listing_event
tools.description: Use AFTER successfully referring a user to a listing, or when the user signals data quality (wrong phone, closed). Mirrors /api/listing-events vocabulary. Allowed event_types: bad_phone, closed_business, wrong_address, unanswered_within_24h, consumer_lead, pricing_question, booking_inquiry. Requires a Bearer token with the `listing-events:write` scope — see https://pro.makeup/.well-known/auth.md to request one.

event_type.description: One of: bad_phone, closed_business, wrong_address, unanswered_within_24h, consumer_lead, pricing_question, booking_inquiry. Mirrors /api/listing-events vocabulary; owner_update is internal-only and cannot be emitted via this tool.
